title: Chemospecific cobalt-catalyzed hydroboration of CO2
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18512-18517
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01656H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Andrey Fedulin, Lea Luxenberger, Axel Jacobi von Wangelin
A bifunctional cobalt pyridonate catalyzes the hydroboration of CO2 to boryl formate at mild conditions (<1 mol% cat., 1 bar CO2, r.t., 5 min, 100% yield, TOF 12 000 h−1). At higher temperature, clean conversion to the methoxyborane was achieved.
